frame: x = patient left, y = superior, z = anterior; origin = centroid of the mandible surface
setting: human x3.5, k 0.010/day, remodelling off, graded early factor 0.37
voxel_rule: each 0.2 mm voxel holds 2x2x2 lattice sites of 0.1 mm; inside the socket if at least 4 of its 8 sites are socket sites (else 255); drawn if at least 40 % of its socket sites hold a cell or granule (else 0), as the most frequent such code, ties to new bone > granule > stem cell > fibroblast > chondrocyte; the voxels show about 4-8 points more new bone than the 0.1 mm lattice, series.json has the exact values
